name: TextField
description: Single-line or multi-line text input with a label, help text and error message.

label.description: Visible label. Required so the field is always named.

description.description: Help text shown under the input.

errorMessage.description: Shown when the field is invalid.

placeholder.description: Example value. Never a replacement for the label.

multiline.description: Renders a textarea instead of an input.

isDisabled.description: Prevents editing and dims the field.

isInvalid.description: Marks the value as invalid and shows errorMessage.

isRequired.description: Marks the field as required for form submission.

onChange.description: Called with the new value on every edit.

keyboard: Tab moves focus in and out
requirements: Label is always rendered and linked to the input
Description and error are linked with aria-describedby
Invalid state is exposed with aria-invalid
screenReader: On focus: the label, then the field type (edit text), then the description
Required fields are announced as required
Invalid: announced as invalid, and the error message is read
Multiline fields are announced as multi-line

use_when: Collecting free-form text such as names, emails or notes
avoid_when: Picking from a known list: use Select or Combobox
anti_patterns: Placeholder used as the only label
Showing errors before the user has finished typing

Passing isInvalid for required or format checks (even isInvalid={false}): any defined value takes over validity and hides the built-in errors. Use isRequired and validate; pass isInvalid only for errors the app finds itself, such as from the server
